open_points.subject: advance_run
open_points.text: If any NodeExecution of the run is refused_by_owner it reaches nothing and ends the run refused.
open_points.other_text: When nothing can execute: if any element waits, the run rests awaiting_approval when one waits with reason owner_approval, otherwise pending, with one WaitingPoint per waiting element; if nothing waits, the run ends succeeded when every node concluded succeeded or skipped_by_guard and failed otherwise, a mapped node whose delivered value list is over the stored value ceiling counting as failed by the same derivation, with no record of its own, with ended_at set and no waiting points.
open_points.question: Must a run containing a refused_by_owner execution end refused, or does the failed-otherwise rule make it failed when nothing waits?
